column1: # Model matrix for the KV-compression PERFORMANCE sweep (throughput / latency / memory).
# Read by scripts/slurm/launch_kv_perf.sh (set MATRIX=scripts/kv_perf_models.tsv), so the
# per-model flag set is defined exactly once. Tab-separated; '#' and blank lines ignored.
# Columns:
#   key        short name used in result paths and job names
#   hf_model   HF id
#   attn       attn_implementation. PINNED, never left to the loader: hf_adapter.py:376-386
#              silently falls back FA2 -> sdpa, and a fallback makes the cell incomparable.
#              dtype+attn are part of the anchor key for exactly this reason.
#   dtype      first-order timing variable, so it is explicit and part of the cell identity
#   trc        trust_remote_code
#   dequant    dequantize_fp8 (FP8 checkpoints only; streams to BF16 at load)
#   maxlen     max_model_len
#   contexts   comma list of context token counts, or 'all'
#   walltimes  comma list aligned positionally to `contexts`
#   label      display name
# Values are copied from the validated combos in scripts/full_kv_models.tsv, not guessed.
# Context caps: a cell must leave room for the question block + decode steps inside the
# model's window, so the top length is below max_position_embeddings (the driver refuses
# to silently truncate). Qwen3-8B stops at 32768: its 40960 window makes 64k/128k pure
# extrapolation, the same restriction the RULER matrix encodes.
